name: Bonn

origin.originalLicense: Same license as the Scriptoscope repository. An original design celebrating the city of Bonn: stylised pixel-art landmarks (the Minster, the Altes Rathaus, the Post Tower, the Langer Eugen), a Beethoven bust and a stylised shield inspired by the City of Bonn's arms, drawn in code; no photographs or traced artworks.

notes: The zoom box and the scheme icon show a stylised shield inspired by the City of Bonn's arms (a black cross on white over a gold lion on red), a simplified pixel emblem rather than a heraldic reproduction of the arms.
